svg.text: Warm evaluation of six CEL fixtures with guest JIT excluded; both engines interpret the expression. Interpreter lower in 12 of
Bars: JVM mean of three JMH fork means (5 × 1 s warmup, 5 × 1 s measurement, C2 host compiler); Native Image median of three fresh-process medians (Serial GC). Whiskers: minimum–maximum of

Ordinary Map inputs; every fixture except scalar binds all 69 variables, and repeated protobuf materializes every output element. Chips compare with the lower cel-java planner aggregate in that panel.
Prepared immutable inputs are a separate control, not pooled here.
Hot timing excludes preparation and warmup; it is not first-request latency. The host may still compile both engines’ Java code on the JVM.
TruffleCEL 0.11.0 (620a961b4020) · TruffleData 0.11.0 · GraalVM 25.5.5-elide.28 · measured 2026-11-10 · Linux x86-64 · AMD Ryzen Threadripper PRO 9965WX
